items.title: MoonPay and Highnote file for national bank charters
items.why: A Highnote charter could let it issue cards directly, making it a card-issuing partner to watch.
items.summary_ai: MoonPay and Highnote have applied for national trust bank charters, joining other fintechs seeking bank status.
items.take: A Highnote charter could let it issue cards directly, making it a card-issuing partner to watch.

items.title: Highnote files for national bank charter
items.why: A card-issuing platform gaining a charter could compete directly for embedded card programs, so track its partner pipeline.
items.summary_ai: Embedded finance firm Highnote has applied for a national bank charter, with BNY and Lowe's named as clients.
items.take: A card-issuing platform gaining a charter could compete directly for embedded card programs, so track its partner pipeline.
